system.flavor:
Swap places with a prisoner in a cell, trade a guard for a friend on the far side of a gate, change two crates in a storeroom, or move someone off a crumbling floor by taking their place.

Not enough to swap anyone out of sight or anything heavier than a person.

body.label: Target
body.html: Two creatures within 5 units and 2 units of each other.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Compare against each unwilling target. Swap their spaces only if both consent or are hit and each fits. Each hit enemy also becomes Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn, even if the swap fails.

surges.html: One willing swapped creature gains +1 Fortitude until the start of your next turn and may move 1 unit.

rider.title: Chaos Thread
rider.html: Gain a Chaos Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: change its Damage type to Fire, Cold, Lightning, Acid, Force or Arcane. Conditions do not change.
